CustomField.label: Summary Display
CustomField.description: Controls whether the result summary is hidden or appears above or below the individual Check results. When resolved Checks have categories, category summaries replace the overall totals. When there are no categories, one overall totals summary appears. The selected position applies in either case. Defaults to Show below checks.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Choose Show above checks, Show below checks, or Hide. Hide removes all summary groups without hiding individual Check results. Categories replace the overall totals with category summaries; otherwise one overall totals summary appears.
